planTitle: Final normalization pass for currently “closer” routes so no active page is left unreviewed
summary: Normalized auth, intake, and workshop status routes to adhere strictly to the shared design system. Removed legacy `border-slate` and hard shadows, substituting them with `bg-surface-container` tonal layering, semantic color tokens, and `shadow-sm`. Cleaned up the placeholder files (`IntakeModalPage`, `RepairOrder`, `SettlementPrint`) with baseline surface tokens. Verified no ESLint errors and client builds successfully.
